And with powerful and intuitive tools, such as CloudKit Console, you can focus on delivering great apps while iCloud handles the details of scaling, consistency, and security. Verify identity and establish trust Identity & Trust gives you access to the same Oblivious HTTP relays, Privacy Pass attestation, and Private Information Retrieval pipelines used by Apple’s own products. Onboard once in CloudKit Console and manage all your integrations from a single place. Learn about Identity & Trust Display curated data with Dashboards Surface trends from Telemetry and usage data with Dashboards. Use customizable widgets to display only the most relevant data to help you identify and resolve issues within your CloudKit containers and push notification-enabled apps. Learn about Dashboards Build apps using CloudKit Develop apps with world-class authentication, privacy, security, and syncing using the same technologies used by Apple in its most popular cloud offerings. CloudKit provides a robust framework and a comprehensive set of tools that make it easy for you to develop powerful apps that seamlessly sync across iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, watchOS, visionOS and the web. Learn about CloudKit Gain insights with Telemetry Tailor your apps for responsiveness and relevance to your users by measuring user activity, CloudKit database usage, and trends over time. With Telemetry’s monitoring and analytics features, you can visualize aggregate behavior across all of your users’ devices for all of the data coming into your container. Learn about Telemetry Access logs that respect user privacy Easily collect, process, and analyze data while keeping your users’ data private. CloudKit’s detailed logs of server activity don’t contain any personal or private data, so you’ll have everything you need to debug and analyze your app while ensuring sensitive user data stays safe and secure. Learn about logs Send, validate, and monitor push notifications Use the interactive web interface to send test push notifications to Apple devices through the Apple Push Notifications service (APNs). Review and manage the channels you use for broadcast push notifications. Access logs that provide insights into the delivery process and leverage tools to generate and validate tokens. Aggregated metrics give you insights into various statistics for device push notifications, including a detailed breakdown based on push type and priority. Learn about Push Notifications Resources Find the tools and documentation you need to build apps that use CloudKit. Notifications can display a message, play a distinctive sound, or update a badge on your app icon. New Broadcast push notifications The all-new broadcast capability from APNs makes it easier for you to deliver updates to your Live Activities at scale. With broadcast push notifications, you can now reach all your subscribed users by sending just a single push notification. Watch the video Learn more Push Notifications Console The Push Notifications Console includes an intuitive web interface that lets you easily send push notifications to validate the end-to-end push functionality of your app. And you can view metrics for device push notifications you send through production APNs, with an aggregated view of delivery statuses and insights into various statistics. https://developer.apple.com/app-store/.visible_text: App Store - Apple Developer View in English Apple Developer Get Started Explore Get Started Overview Learn Apple Developer Program Stay Updated Latest News Hello Developer Platforms Explore Platforms Apple Platforms iOS iPadOS macOS tvOS visionOS watchOS App Store Featured Design Distribution Games Accessories Web Home CarPlay Technologies Explore Technologies Overview Xcode Swift SwiftUI Featured Accessibility AI & Machine Learning App Intents Apple Intelligence Games Security Xcode Cloud Community Explore Community Overview Meet with Apple events Community events Developer Forums Open Source Featured WWDC Swift Student Challenge Developer Stories App Store Awards Apple Design Awards Apple Developer Centers Documentation Explore Documentation Documentation Library Technology Overviews Sample Code Human Interface Guidelines Videos Release Notes Featured Updates iOS iPadOS macOS watchOS visionOS tvOS Xcode Downloads Explore Downloads All Downloads Operating Systems Applications Design Resources Featured Xcode TestFlight Fonts SF Symbols Icon Composer Support Explore Support Overview Help Guides Developer Forums Feedback Assistant Contact Us Featured Account Help App Review Guidelines App Store Connect Help Upcoming Requirements Agreements and Guidelines System Status Quick Links Events News Forums Sample Code Videos   --> App Store Open Menu Close Menu Overview What’s New Get Started Resources Reach a global audience on the App Store Distribute your apps and games on the App Store and reach people on more than 2 billion devices around the world. Take advantage of discovery features, a world-class commerce platform, marketing tools, and analytics to make the most of your business on the App Store. --> Explore what’s new Discover the latest features and enhancements to help make your apps, games, and Apple In-App Purchases shine on the App Store. New to the App Store? Check out our easy-to-navigate collection of resources to help you start distributing your apps and games. Publish your apps and games Get details and considerations for publishing your apps and games on the App Store. Understand the review guidelines, how to submit for review, and more. Learn more Get to know the App Store Reach a global audience, across Apple platforms. The App Store makes it easy for you to distribute your apps and games whether you’re a solo developer, or a part of an enterprise team. With availability in 175 regions and 50 languages, people around the world can discover your apps and games on the App Store, empowering you to grow your business worldwide. A trusted marketplace that works to help you succeed. With every app, update, Apple In-App Purchase, and In-App Event on the App Store reviewed for safety, security, and privacy, people can confidently download and purchase your apps, games, and offerings. Learn about submitting Built to support kids and families. Apple provides robust tools — including developer frameworks and age ratings — to help you design safe and appropriate experiences in your apps and games. We also provide tools for parents like Screen Time and Ask to Buy to help them determine what’s best for their children and manage their purchases. Learn more Support to keep you moving forward. From accessing Apple experts through Meet with Apple, to comprehensive guides, documentation, and more, we’ve got you covered. Receive code-level support and get your questions answered in Apple Developer Forums, so you can get unblocked and keep moving forward. And if customer issues arise, AppleCare is available to provide people with support related to their purchases, billing issues, and more. Learn more Explore discovery features Featuring Nominations. Share your story with us using Featuring Nominations in App Store Connect. Our editorial team’s mission is to showcase incredible apps and games that people will love across Apple platforms. We highlight content in a variety of ways, from dedicated stories and featured In-App Events to charts and lists, and even personalized recommendations. Learn about getting featured and how to submit a nomination Marketing tools. Promote your app with ready-made badges, QR codes, and marketing assets customized to your app or game. Easily download and use these assets and links to boost your marketing efforts — all while saving on design work and budget. Get assets to share a launch, new version, special offer, or App Store featuring. View the App Store marketing toolbox Learn additional ways to promote your app App Store search. People can find exactly what they need with App Store search, which goes beyond just displaying apps and games. Search results can surface content like In-App Events, developer stories, categories, collections, custom product pages, and more. Plus, app tags give people more ideas to explore, further amplifying discovery. Learn about App Store search Custom product pages. Highlight your best features, such as a particular sport, character, show, or gameplay features. Create unique pages that each cater to specific audiences and share them through your marketing channels, like email or social, helping you drive stronger conversion. Learn about custom product pages Product page optimization. Test different elements of your App Store product page — including app icons, screenshots, and app preview videos — to understand which best resonate with people and result in the most engagement and conversion. Learn about product page optimization In-App Events. Showcase your game competitions, movie premieres, live-streamed experiences and more, right on the App Store with In-App Events. People can tap to learn more, download your app or game, and then dive right in. In-App Events can help people discover, engage, and even come back to your apps and games. Learn about In-App Events Commerce tools to help you grow Apple In-App Purchases give you everything you need to monetize and scale your business — from one-time purchases, to subscriptions, and beyond. Choose from a variety of business models to seamlessly offer your Apple In-App Purchases to people across markets and Apple platforms. Purchases through the App Store use a customer’s payment method on file, removing friction at the most critical moment to help you better convert, without any extra effort on your end. Learn more about Apple In-App Purchases Simple, secure checkout. Customers can make purchases on the App Store and within your apps and games with their payment method on file. This creates a seamless experience for them as they can stay within your apps and games, offering you stronger conversion. Built to support your global growth. With end-to-end payment processing handled, you can offer your goods and services using Apple In-App Purchases in a single, central place, without having to coordinate with multiple payment providers. Support for more than 200 payment methods — including credit and debit cards, carrier billing, digital wallets, and more — empowers people to pay with their preferred regional method. Plus, international pricing tools provide you with flexibility when pricing your purchases across every region they’re offered, allowing you to reach customers around the world and maximize your revenue. Subscription tools to help you attract and keep subscribers. Auto-renewable subscriptions offer best-in-class tools and features to help you provide customers with options that are just right for each individual. With a variety of configuration options, people can easily upgrade and downgrade their subscription to one that best fits their needs. Reach customers at every stage of the journey with four types of offers: introductory, promotional, win-back, and offer codes. Plus, tools like billing retry, grace periods, and retention messages help remedy failed payments and minimize cancellations. Explore subscriptions Analytics to help move your business forward Access data and metrics you won’t find anywhere else and make decisions with confidence using Analytics in App Store Connect. Get performance insights. View key metrics — like sales, subscription performance, referral sources, engagement, and more. Layer on different dimensions and filters to your selected metrics to uncover specific insights that help you move the needle for your apps and games. Understand how you stack up to your peers. Benchmark your app or game’s performance against similar ones on the App Store, based on category, business model, and download volume. Learn where you’re leading and where there are opportunities to improve so you can provide a great user experience. Measuring performance with Analytics Apple Games app An all-in-one destination for players to get even more out of their gaming experience. The Games app brings players and their friends together in one convenient place where they can discover, launch, and engage with games on their iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Players can challenge one another, play together in a multiplayer match, gain achievements, and so much more. Learn more about the Games app Developer stories Global success stories Three developers share their experiences about expanding to a global audience. Read more Breaking barriers Find out how the Lingvano team reaches the ASL community and its advocates. Read more Start small, code big Get insights from three devs who did big things with small teams. Read more App Store Awards are exceptional in quality. App Store Awards are presented to apps and games that have demonstrated a positive cultural impact worldwide. The App Store Awards are a global celebration of the best apps and games of the year — selected by our team of editors. As always, we focus on technical innovation, user experience, and design. Then we consider the impact these apps and games have had on our users’ lives. We honor finalists and winners across every platform as well as ones with the greatest cultural impact.
